name: BitcoinWhosWho (address report pages)
tier_rationale: Long-running address reputation site with public documentation and a paid API (A8 community); P216 cond 5: 'community - mempool.space, WalletExplorer, BitcoinWhosWho, Ethplorer'.

reliability.justification: Scam reports, web mentions and tags contributed by users and crawlers: leads, never proof.

address_pages.title: BitcoinWhosWho address report /address/{btc_address} (manual pivot links)

terms.quote: The pack is offline data (disclosure 'none'): V3LUM never requests these URLs or any API behind them.

address_pages.notes: Quote: binding council text (P216 cond 1). Research C0504 terms 'Free web UI; provider ToS apply (manual analyst use)'. On 2026-11-26 curl got 302 to the plain-http home page: the link is unverified until a browser re-check. The API needs a key and is not used. Used by pivots_crypto (pack crypto.json).

notes: Manual pivot links only (batch p2-G14-2): V3LUM never fetches them (P311).
